interactives.assumptions: Assumed 5cm leaf, 50µm cells, 500µm tissue region; bars calibrated to model panels only. Leaf schematic, real cells vary.
10× eyepiece, objectives 4/10/40×, assumed field diameters 2/0.8/0.2mm; 50µm model cells. Focus midpoint preset. Dot comparison is geometric, not a diffraction simulation.
Hypothetical A can cross and B cannot under preset conditions. No diffusion, osmosis, protein transport or energy simulation. Bacterium with wall selected; DNA not enclosed by nucleus.
Baking yeast budding and plant cooperation are compressed schematic stages, not real-time microscopy. Yeast bud is not an organ. No culturing task.
